author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Upright banknote with a round mark held in a fist: sleeve edges and cuff at the left, a thumb rising onto the note's edge, and a round r10 knuckle side with a finger crease. Reads as a hand gripping a bill at 48 in both themes; the before read as a note over a loose line.
omissions: The note's slight taper (vertical sides give the mark exact 8-unit clearances); the mark is an r2 ring (renders solid) because the note is 20 wide.
